stop_condition: Done when the transitive closure has been checked once for a text path the self-check cannot see, and the self-check itself has been checked once for a definition form or call shape it misses; then either a finding at or above high, or verdict=approve with findings=[]. BOUNDED: no exhaustive proof of absence. make lint must stay 0, the spec must stay 108/0, sections 1-2Q must stay at 62, and both review-check baselines must not move.

findings.evidence: verified_state_unchanged_detail emits editable static prose, its output is assigned to SUITE_REUSE_DETAIL at line 5104, and checks_scope_note emits that variable into the operator block at line 5649.
